text: とり　つかれるとは　わしも　まだまだ…

structure.jp: とり　つかれるとは

structure.en: I too still have a long way to go...

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.span: とり　つかれるとは
patterns.explanation: とは after a statement shows surprise or dismay at it, like 'to think that'. とりつかれるとは = 'to think I'd get possessed'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: とりつかれる is とりつく 'to possess' turned around, so it is done to the speaker. とりつかれる = 'get possessed'.
